messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D-style phone/tablet-friendly game from the supplied HTML concept.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- Support responsive mobile layouts and usable touch controls.

## Decisions
- Replaced the supplied studio concept with an original single-file endless runner, “NEON DRIFT — SKYLINE RUN,” using canvas-rendered pseudo-3D visuals.
- Implemented three-lane steering, traffic hazards, collectible sparks, boost energy, scoring, persistent best score, pause/resume, sound toggle, keyboard and touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the playable game in `index.html`.
- Confirmed JavaScript syntax with `node --check`.
- Started the local server and verified the game loads and runs in Playwright.
- Captured and inspected screenshots at `/tmp/opencode/neon-drift.jpg` and `/tmp/opencode/neon-drift-play.jpg`.

### Active
- Refined road perspective after screenshot inspection: changed `roadPoint()` vertical projection and lane dash placement. Recheck visuals and gameplay after this latest change.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the latest road perspective in browser and verify hazards/sparks align with the player’s lanes.
2. Check browser console for errors beyond the expected missing `/favicon.ico` 404.
3. Finish with a concise summary of game features, checks, and any reasonable assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game implementation, styling, canvas renderer, and controls.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local server is running at `http://localhost:3000`.
- Initial screenshot showed the road/projected objects too low and compressed; latest change altered `roadPoint()` to use `t*t` vertically and lane dashes to use linear `t`, but this visual adjustment has not yet been verified.
